authorities.paraphrase: The Academy distinguishes news/information from literary fiction.
The pronominal verb denotes speaking in an exclamation.
Human species is distinct from an approximate sort in espèce de.
Livre blanc denotes a book with no written content, distinct from color as a noun.
Philosophical spatial extension is an adjective meaning, independent of gender and number.
The complete adverbial formula indicates the interval through the present moment.
The complete formula introduces the speaker’s standpoint.
The complete locution introduces an illustration.
In the color construction, a hue approaches the named color.
